subject.title: [Feature]: Merge iOS Privacy and Location card state

question: Should Settings > Privacy merge the Location-derived Privacy summary into a single Location card now, using a Location Sharing switch plus Access Level row, or should that UI wait for the broader Always/background-location permission direction?
rationale: This changes native Settings UX and privacy-permission wording, and the reporter has already claimed active work, so automation should not decide the product shape alone.

options.title: Approve narrow Location card merge
options.body: Proceed with the focused card merge and tests while keeping the broader Always/background-location posture tracked separately.

options.title: Fold into broader location permission work
options.body: Hold this issue until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99229 decides the effective authorization and Always-permission flow.

options.title: Keep existing cards for now
options.body: Leave Privacy and Location as separate visible sections until maintainers decide the current redundancy is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow Location card merge
recommendation.body: Proceed with the focused card merge and tests while keeping the broader Always/background-location posture tracked separately.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete recently merged adjacent iOS Privacy settings work and is the strongest routing candidate for this UX direction choice.
